name: bb_mcuhub
description: The bb_mcuhub C chassis (§08): the communication logic a hub gateway needs on the MCU — COBS+CRC framing, the transport seam, the meaning-blind router, the cooperative scheduler, the born-disarmed/fail-passive floor, CAN segmentation, and the ESP32/arduino-esp32 link layer (UART host link + UART/TWAI backplane) plus the generic hub main loop. A consumer pulls this via lib_deps and adds ONLY its robot's generated per-hub glue (-Igen/<slug>) and its hand-authored device hooks (mcu/<hub>.cpp). The arduino-esp32 glue under src/esp32 is #if defined(ARDUINO)-guarded, so the same sources compile in the host C harnesses (built via firmware/test/Makefile, not PlatformIO).
